text: {"headline":"Review of K17 batch tensile runs and subsequent workbook revision","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records and attributed allegations concerning K17 batch testing, workbook values, and related presentations for reviewer assessment without additional factual inference.","key_points":["On 4 March 2026, PERSON_1 recorded six failed tensile runs for batch K17 [C001]","The K17 run IDs end 071 through 076 and each carries the instrument's clamp-slip flag [C002, C003]","A documented allegation states that two days later PERSON_2 replaced the six failed runs with copied values from batch K12 in the investor workbook [C006], and the revised workbook has the same six decimal values and ordering as K12 including 42.137 MPa twice [C004, C016]","The investor chart omits the run IDs which makes reconciliation impossible without the workbook [C005], while PERSON_2's methods memo says every plotted K17 value came from a fresh run [C009]","In early April PERSON_2 presented the revised K17 chart to the review panel [C007], the following Monday PERSON_1 requested the raw instrument files for batch K17 [C010], and after the audit PERSON_1 put the original machine export in read-only storage [C008]","No clinical or product safety claim was tested by this experiment [C011], no signed audit report was available for this packet [C017], and an import mistake has not been ruled out as an explanation for the matching values [C012]"],"risk_notes":["Reconciliation risk noted in records due to omission of run IDs from investor chart, limiting traceability to source runs","Inconsistency between methods memo statement about fresh runs and documented allegation of copied values remains unresolved on the current record","Reliance on single-document sources for key events without independent corroboration noted in verification"],"limitations":["Evidence does not establish intent, knowledge, or motive behind the workbook revision","Evidence does not provide independent proof beyond the documented allegation that values were copied; alternative explanation of import mistake remains not ruled out","Evidence does not show clinical or product safety impact, as no such claim was tested by this experiment","Evidence does not show what, if any, caveat was communicated at the panel presentation, and reporter recollections about a temporary stand-in are unverified and not independently documented","Evidence does not include a signed audit report for this packet"]}
